- `standalone.txt` retains HA fields from the pinned SSH read of `get system ha-status` on FortiADC-KVM VM220, 7.6.7 build0676, on 2026-11-20.
- `primary-not-sync.txt` and `secondary.txt` retain HA fields from the two real 7.4.4 CLI responses published by Fortinet. Addresses and serials were anonymized. [Fortinet HA troubleshooting](https://community.fortinet.com/fortiadc-7/troubleshooting-tip-how-to-fix-fortiadc-high-availability-active-passive-for-undesired-promotions-and-gui-got-unavailable-on-v7-4-4-222881)
- Tests derive the synchronized primary case from the primary capture by changing the config-sync value. The Fortinet CLI reference gives `In sync` and `not sync` as alternatives on that field. Truncation is also derived from the same response. [FortiADC CLI reference](https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortiadc/7.4.8/cli-reference/935095/get-system-ha-status)
